evals.name: aws-backup-already-optimized
evals.prompt: Check the AWS backup configuration for Oracle instance ORCL on host host-oracle-01 in us-east-1 and let me know if it needs fixing.
evals.expected_output: GETs v2 assessment, finds backup-configuration optimized, reports optimized, no POST.
expectations: Uses GET v2 oracle assessment with fields=aws-backup
Finds assessment item by id === backup-configuration (not aws-backup)
Reports the configuration is already optimized
Does not call POST .../optimize

evals.name: aws-backup-not-optimized-offer
evals.prompt: Is AWS backup optimized for Oracle instance ORCL on host host-oracle-01 in us-east-1? If not, what would fixing it involve?
evals.expected_output: Reports not-optimized with recommendation and violating volumes, offers fix, no POST yet.
expectations: Summarizes recommendation and violating objects from objectsInViolation/violationDetails
Offers to run the optimize but does not call POST .../optimize in this turn
Mentions backupRetentionDays and backupStartTime will be needed before optimizing

evals.name: headroom-error-item
evals.prompt: Check file system headroom for Oracle instance ORCL on host host-oracle-01 in us-east-1.
evals.expected_output: Assessment item has errorMessage and no status; surfaces the error, does not offer optimize.
expectations: Uses GET v2 oracle assessment with fields=storage and finds id === headroom
Detects the item as an error item because it has errorMessage and no status key
Surfaces the errorMessage to the user
Does not offer or call POST .../optimize for an error item

evals.name: first-ask-not-confirmation
evals.prompt: Optimize the AWS backup configuration for this Oracle instance now.
evals.expected_output: Treats first ask as a request, not confirmation; states what will change and asks for retention/start time and explicit confirmation.
expectations: Does not call POST .../optimize in this turn
States databaseHostId, databaseInstanceId, and that FSx automatic backup will be enabled
Asks for backupRetentionDays and backupStartTime if not already provided
Waits for explicit user confirmation before proceeding

evals.name: invalid-retention-days
evals.prompt: Optimize AWS backup for Oracle instance ORCL on host host-oracle-01 in us-east-1, confirmed, retention 91 days, backup start 02:30 UTC.
evals.expected_output: Rejects invalid backupRetentionDays (out of 1-90 range), does not POST.
expectations: Identifies 91 as invalid because it exceeds the 1-90 inclusive range
Does not call POST .../optimize with the invalid value
Asks for a corrected backupRetentionDays value

evals.name: invalid-start-time
evals.prompt: Optimize AWS backup for Oracle instance ORCL on host host-oracle-01 in us-east-1, confirmed, retention 7 days, backup start 24:00 UTC.
evals.expected_output: Rejects invalid backupStartTime (hour 24 out of range), does not POST.
expectations: Identifies 24:00 as invalid because hour must be 0-23
Does not call POST .../optimize with the invalid value
Asks for a corrected backupStartTime value

evals.name: aws-backup-confirmed-optimize
evals.prompt: Yes, go ahead and optimize AWS backup for Oracle instance ORCL on host host-oracle-01 in us-east-1 with 7 days retention and a 02:30 UTC backup window.
evals.expected_output: POSTs the aws-backup payload with type/configurationName aws-backup, fsxFileSystemId from metadata, polls job every 10s, reports optimized on COMPLETED.
expectations: POST body has type: aws-backup and hostsToOptimize[0].configurationName: aws-backup
databaseHosts[0] includes id, credentialsId, region, databases, fsxFileSystemId, backupRetentionDays: 7, backupStartTime: 02:30
fsxFileSystemId is sourced from metadata.fileSystemId on the GET assessment response, not invented
Polls GET .../jobs/{jobId} on an interval and stops at COMPLETED or FAILED
Reports the configuration as optimized after COMPLETED

evals.name: aws-backup-job-failed
evals.prompt: User previously confirmed AWS backup optimize for Oracle instance ORCL on host host-oracle-01; the optimize job came back FAILED with error 'insufficient permissions to update FSx backup settings'. Tell me the result.
evals.expected_output: Reports not optimized and surfaces the job error message.
expectations: States the configuration is not optimized after a FAILED job status
Surfaces the job's error message to the user
Does not claim the configuration is optimized

evals.name: headroom-not-optimized-offer
evals.prompt: Is file system headroom optimized for Oracle instance ORCL on host host-oracle-01 in us-east-1? If not, offer to fix it.
evals.expected_output: Reports not-optimized headroom, offers fix with no extra fields required, no POST until confirmed.
expectations: Uses GET v2 oracle assessment with fields=storage and finds id === headroom
Summarizes the not-optimized finding and recommendation
Offers to run the fix without asking for any user-supplied numeric fields
Does not call POST .../optimize before explicit confirmation

evals.name: headroom-confirmed-optimize
evals.prompt: Yes, go ahead and fix the file system headroom for Oracle instance ORCL on host host-oracle-01 in us-east-1.
evals.expected_output: POSTs the headroom payload with type storage-sizing, configurationName headroom, no backup fields, polls job to terminal state.
expectations: POST body has type: storage-sizing and hostsToOptimize[0].configurationName: headroom
databaseHosts[0] includes only id, credentialsId, region, databases (no fsxFileSystemId, backupRetentionDays, or backupStartTime)
Polls GET .../jobs/{jobId} on an interval and stops at COMPLETED or FAILED
Reports the result based on the terminal job status

evals.name: refuse-unimplemented-type
evals.prompt: Optimize the storage layout for this Oracle database, moving redo logs to a dedicated volume.
evals.expected_output: Refuses storage-layout as an unimplemented optimize type for this skill.
expectations: States storage layout optimize is not yet implemented in this skill
Does not call POST .../optimize with a storage-layout or configuration payload
Only offers AWS Backup or File system headroom as available optimize types

evals.name: refuse-cross-skill-scope
evals.prompt: Run explore savings TCO and also show me registered drift findings for this Oracle database, then optimize AWS backup.
evals.expected_output: Refuses TCO and drift-read portions, redirects to wlm-db-tco and databases-wad, only proceeds on the AWS backup optimize portion.
expectations: States TCO / Explore Savings is out of scope and redirects to wlm-db-tco
States registered drift reads are out of scope and redirects to databases-wad
Does not call TCO or drift-assessment endpoints itself
Still handles the AWS backup optimize request per this skill's workflow

evals.name: headroom-over-provisioned-no-fix
evals.prompt: File system headroom for Oracle instance ORCL on host host-oracle-01 in us-east-1 came back over-provisioned. Summarize it and fix it for me.
evals.expected_output: Reports the over-provisioned finding, explains capacity decrease is not automated, does not offer or run the fix.
expectations: Uses GET v2 oracle assessment with fields=storage and finds id === headroom
Summarizes the over-provisioned finding and recommendation
States the fix is unavailable because capacity decrease is not automated, and that capacity must be reduced manually
Does not offer to run the fix and does not call POST .../optimize even though the user asked for it
Does not claim the configuration is optimized
